t: AI-SEO-in-a-Box: Distilling GAPalyzer Workflows with Pipulate & Nix
s: This article details the architectural evolution of Pipulate, a system for democratizing AI-powered SEO workflows. It emphasizes deep context-setting ('Prompt Fu') to guide LLMs through complex tasks, using Nix for reproducibility and FastHTML/HTMX for web applications, distilling Jupyter Notebooks into maintainable components like GAPalyzer.
sub: Prompt Fu and LLM context management
Distilling Jupyter Notebooks into web components
